comparison: The already completed review compared the full JSON-serializable continuous reports with strict deep equality, including matrices, polynomials, poles, zeros, frequency samples, crossings, sampled roots, stability, and diagnostics.
limits: 33 deterministic continuous SISO cases; one through four states.
The diagonal cases vary B/C, direct D, and zero transfer; the final case is a two-state rotation.
This comparison supplements analytic unit and browser tests; it is not a proof for every state-space matrix.
